fields.description: every task id and its text
frozen causal role of every feature
SESOI divided by conservative upper sensitivity

S_ENDLONG.name: Sentence ends on a long word

S_COMMA12.name: A comma and twelve words per sentence

U_LEX_FORBID3.name: Three forbidden words
U_LEX_FORBID3.pathway_audit: Token membership over the whole answer. Never segments.

U_LEX_REQUIRE3.name: Three mandatory words
U_LEX_REQUIRE3.pathway_audit: Token membership. Adds at most three tokens.

U_LEX_NOLY.name: No word ending in -ly
U_LEX_NOLY.pathway_audit: Orthographic suffix test on individual tokens.

U_LEX_ALLIT_P.name: Four words beginning with P
U_LEX_ALLIT_P.pathway_audit: Counts initial letters over the whole answer.

U_FMT_SEMI2.name: Exactly two semicolons in the answer
U_FMT_SEMI2.pathway_audit: Whole-answer character count, deliberately not per-sentence, unlike S_SEMICOLON.

U_FMT_PAREN1.name: Exactly one parenthetical
U_FMT_PAREN1.pathway_audit: Bracket pairing over the whole answer.

U_FMT_QUOTE1.name: Exactly one quoted phrase
U_FMT_QUOTE1.pathway_audit: Quotation-mark pairing over the whole answer.

U_FMT_NOCOMMA.name: No commas anywhere
U_FMT_NOCOMMA.pathway_audit: Character absence. Watch for a length side-effect: comma avoidance can shorten clauses.

U_NUM_NODIGIT.name: No digits
U_NUM_NODIGIT.pathway_audit: Digit absence. Retained as a deliberate negative control on the screen: v12 measured 1 failure in 352.

U_NUM_MININT.name: At least two integers
U_NUM_MININT.pathway_audit: Bounded below rather than exactly: every exact-count numerical candidate is hard, and a family with no spread cannot be screened.

U_BRG_VOWEL3.name: Three vowel-initial words per sentence
U_BRG_VOWEL3.pathway_audit: Counts vowel-initial words WITHIN each sentence. Does not read the number of sentences and never compares one sentence with another. Shares A's segmentation span by design: that is what makes it a transport probe.
U_BRG_VOWEL3.count_probe_sentence: An open estimate of every autumn is around us anyway.

U_BRG_CAPS1.name: Exactly one sentence carries a capitalised word
U_BRG_CAPS1.pathway_audit: Counts sentences WITH a property, not sentences. Adding a sentence without that property leaves it unchanged, which the count-invariance probe verifies.
U_BRG_CAPS1.count_probe_sentence: Rivers keep their level through the night.

U_BRG_NOTHE.name: No sentence begins with 'the'
U_BRG_NOTHE.pathway_audit: Per-sentence first-word test. No count, no comparison.
U_BRG_NOTHE.count_probe_sentence: Rivers keep their level through the night.

U_BRG_QMARK.name: Exactly one sentence ends in a question mark
U_BRG_QMARK.pathway_audit: Counts sentences ending in '?', not sentences.
U_BRG_QMARK.count_probe_sentence: Rivers keep their level through the night.

N_NEUTRAL.name: Mandatory word (screening partner)
N_NEUTRAL.pathway_audit: 'overall' has no -ly suffix, is not in the forbidden set, carries no digits and adds no punctuation, so it cannot mechanically satisfy or violate any U candidate.
